A [[Human/Legends|Human]] '''individual''' with [[Color/Legends|black]] [[Hair/Legends|hair]] served as an [[Imperial officer/Legends|officer]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during the aftermath of the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. Around the time of the [[Battle of Kalist VI]], they were featured in an Imperial [[Propaganda/Legends|propaganda]] news feed.
